title: Simulator, trained Q-table, and per-seed results for "Age- and Link-Lifetime-Aware Resource Allocation in UAV–IoV–MEC Networks via RL-Guided PSO–ACO"
description: UAV–IoV–MEC simulator, the RL-guided PSO–ACO optimizer and seven baselines, the trained Q-table, per-interval and per-seed results of all experiments, and Supplementary Tables S1–S4 for the article submitted to Computer Modeling in Engineering & Sciences (CMES). Code is released under the MIT License; data and results under CC BY 4.0.
